trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat it as a finish line rather than a task of its own. Work through the six roadmap stages in order: finish the story, clear the side strands before the finale, grind the activities, sweep the collectibles, clear the combat and heist trophies, then mop up money and secrets. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because the one missable meditation in Chapter 1 cannot be recovered otherwise. Expect roughly 200 hours in total. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish all five story chapters and the finale.
Complete the 100% checklist and every side strand before the finale.
Sweep collectibles, activities and combat trophies in roadmap order.
Check the tracker after each session so nothing is left behind.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start of Chapter 1 and see it through to its end. Follow the on-screen prompts, stay with your partner through the scripted beats, and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Nothing here can be missed, so just enjoy the introduction to Leonida. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1 and begin the Gone Fishing mission.
Follow the mission prompts to the end.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate on Lucia's balcony, because that meditation spot disappears once the chapter ends and the game has no mission replay. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter so you always have a way back. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
Meditate on Lucia's balcony before the chapter ends.
Complete all Chapter 1 story missions.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2's story missions in order until the chapter closes and the trophy pops. During this chapter, keep Jason and Lucia partnered for the combat trophies that need both of them together, and take the fishing challenge when Cal offers it, since it is reported time-sensitive. Save manually at the chapter start. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GTA Zone.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 2.
Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Do the partnered and Cal activities while they are available.

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 3 to close the chapter and pop the trophy. Watch for the Yago race, which carries an hourglass icon and counts toward Strangers & Freaks, and finish Andy's and Tyrone's side strands while the chapter is open. The Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 mission is needed later for an undetected jewelry robbery, so keep the story moving. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.
Complete the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Take the Yago race and finish the Andy and Tyrone strands.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 story missions, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown, and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before moving on, wrap up any side strands still open, since side content is reported to lock once the story passes it. Bank vault robberies open up around this stage of the game. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Complete the Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Finish open side strands before the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Play the final mission of Chapter 5 and complete it to earn this gold trophy and roll the credits. Before you start the finale, finish every side strand, the partnered combat trophies and the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, because the story does not let you go back after this point. Save manually before the finale as a safety net. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish all side strands and partnered trophies first.
Make a manual save before the final mission.
Complete the final mission to earn the gold trophy.

trophies.guide: Play the Breakfast Run story mission in Chapter 2 and finish it to pop the trophy. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the main path, and there is no special condition attached to it. Just follow the mission objectives to the end. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2.
Follow the mission objectives through to the end.
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops when it ends. Heist missions tend to be longer and more combat-heavy than regular story beats, so stock up on ammo and armour before you start, and follow the crew's plan through each phase. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GTA Zone.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Stock up on ammo and armour before starting.
Complete the heist mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Play the Child's Play story mission in Chapter 4 and finish it to earn the trophy. Like the other story mission trophies it pops automatically on completion, with no extra objective to chase, so keep following the main story path and it will come. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4.
Play through the mission objectives.
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the end. It is a straight story completion trophy with no hidden requirement, so play the mission normally, watch the set pieces, and finish the final objective to claim it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Output Lag.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in Chapter 4.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission in Chapter 4 to pop the trophy. Expect a bigger set piece with heavier combat than a standard mission, so go in with full armour and a varied weapon loadout, use cover between pushes, and finish the final objective to close the mission. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4.
Stock armour and weapons before starting.
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Play the Operation Savage Glory story mission in Chapter 5 and complete it to earn the trophy. It sits near the end of the story, so the combat is intense and the mission runs long; keep moving between cover, watch your health, and push through the final objective. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Fight through the mission objectives in order.
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist and this gold trophy pops. The checklist has 14 rows: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 8 bank vaults, 39 illegal operations, 42 gold Shooting Range challenges, 42 drone races, 15 of Bret's target decks, and all underwater discoveries. Work it after the story with the checklist table in this guide open beside you, and keep the Chapter 1 balcony meditation in mind from the very start. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first, then open the 100% checklist table.
Clear the checklist rows one at a time, hardest first.
Track every row in this guide until all 14 read complete.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida to earn this silver trophy. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime moments the game tracks as you drive, so the fastest route is to chain them deliberately: use fast cars, jump ramps and hills, drift through corners, and keep an eye on the stunt counter. There are 397 stunts in total and the 100% checklist needs 300, so pushing past 250 toward 300 kills two goals at once. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Use fast cars and ramps to chain jumps, drifts and airtime.
Watch the stunt counter climb toward 250.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once and the trophy pops. The activity types are spread across Leonida's map and side content, so work through them in one sweep after the story: visit the shooting range, race, fish, play an arcade game, bowl, fly a drone race, and try the rest as the map markers appear. One attempt each is enough, no win required. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GTA Zone.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the map and note the activity markers.
Try one activity of each of the 9 types.
Check the counter until all 9 read done.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges in total, and gold means beating a strict time or accuracy bar on each one, so practice the weapon handling first: learn the recoil, use the range's sight picture, and retry a challenge immediately while the layout is fresh in your head. Steady aim beats fast trigger pulls. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and learn the challenge formats.
Practice recoil control and sight alignment.
Earn gold on all 42 challenges, retrying each while fresh.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total across those 14 spots, and the 100% checklist also needs all 42 won, so treat this as the first half of a bigger goal. Learn each course's gates before racing flat out, cut corners only where the gates allow it, and keep the drone low to hold speed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Learn each course's gates before racing hard.
Win at least one race at every location, then all 42.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. There are 40 races in total, so you only need half of them, but each race counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one you like. Pick the vehicle class you handle best, learn the braking points on the first lap, and use traffic as cover rather than a hazard. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Output Lag.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and pick a vehicle class you handle well.
Win a race, then move to a different one.
Repeat across 20 different races.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge, and do it when he offers it, because this one is reported time-sensitive and may not come back. Fish patiently: watch the line tension, reel steadily rather than yanking, and land the bigger catch before Cal does. If the prompt appears in Chapter 1, take it right away instead of postponing it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: Reported time-sensitive: take the challenge when Cal offers it — it may not come back.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Watch for Cal's fishing challenge offer in Chapter 1.
Accept it immediately when it appears.
Reel steadily and land the bigger catch to beat him.

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start a game, and play it through to completion. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find first and follow its own rules to the end. Arcade machines sit in bars and entertainment spots around the map, so you will likely pass one during the activity sweep. Pick a game with a short run so you can finish it in one sitting, and keep playing until the completion screen shows rather than quitting mid-game. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, gtasix.how.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine in Leonida.
Start any arcade game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, a Lucia-only strand in Chapter 3, before the finale. Side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them, so start Andy's missions as soon as they appear and keep returning to them between story beats instead of leaving them all for the end. Finish the strand fully and the trophy pops on its last mission. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: Andy's strand — finish all his missions before the finale; side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Start Andy's missions as soon as they appear in Chapter 3.
Play as Lucia and return between story beats.
Complete the final mission for Andy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, ending with Maritime Disputes, before the finale. Kenton's strand revolves around 7 shipwrecks, so work through them steadily as they surface and keep the strand moving between story missions. Like every side strand it is reported to lock once the story passes it, so do not leave it until after the finale. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GamesRadar.
trophies.missableNote: Kenton's strand — finish all his missions, ending with Maritime Disputes, before the finale; side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Start Kenton's strand when it appears.
Clear the 7 shipwrecks as they surface.
Complete the final mission, Maritime Disputes, before the finale.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, ending with Hometown Heroes, before the finale. Billy's strand is built around 5 jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, so head there whenever a new job opens and clear them as they come. Side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them, so finish the strand while the story is still open. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: Billy's strand — finish all his missions, ending with Hometown Heroes, before the finale; side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Start Billy's strand in Chapter 2.
Complete the 5 jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Finish with Hometown Heroes before the finale.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The counting strands are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, with 8 strands in total counting toward the trophy, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count. The Yago race in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass icon, so take it the moment it appears or the strand may not count. Work the stranger markers as you travel and keep a manual save at each chapter start. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: Time-sensitive: the Yago race in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass icon — miss it and the strand may not count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Take the Yago race in Chapter 3 the moment its hourglass appears.
Complete the counting strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Reach 8 completed strands across Leonida.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, including his vehicle wish list of 16 sports cars, before the finale. Source the cars from the wish list as you find them around Leonida and deliver them as you go, rather than hunting all 16 at once at the end. Side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GTA Zone.
trophies.missableNote: Randy's strand — finish all his missions, and his vehicle wish list, before the finale; side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Start Randy's strand in Chapter 3.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his wish list as you find them.
Complete the final mission for Randy before the finale.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, a Jason-only strand in Chapter 3, before the finale. His strand includes the Kitty Litter Lab deliveries, so keep up with them as they appear and do not let the strand stall while you chase story missions. Deliveries run on their own schedule, so check back at the lab between story missions instead of waiting beside it. Jason-only strands need Jason in the driving seat, so switch characters before you head over. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.
trophies.missableNote: Tyrone's strand — finish all his missions, and the Kitty Litter Lab deliveries, before the finale; side strands are reported to lock once the story passes them.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Start Tyrone's strand as Jason in Chapter 3.
Keep up with the Kitty Litter Lab deliveries.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone before the finale.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is THE missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends or the trophy is gone for the whole playthrough. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as your safety net. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 spots, so this sweep does double duty. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: THE missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
Meditate on Lucia's balcony before Chapter 1 ends.
Meditate at the remaining 17 spots across Leonida.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret in this Jason-only strand, starting it when it appears and finishing it before the finale. Bret's strand is time-sensitive, so do not leave the hunt sitting while you push the story forward. Track the animal with patience, take the shot cleanly, and return the kill to close the strand. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Output Lag.
trophies.missableNote: Time-sensitive: a Jason-only strand — start it when it appears and finish it before the finale.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Start Bret's strand as Jason when it appears.
Track and hunt the unique animal.
Finish the strand before the finale.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 sets in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so sweep each region methodically and mark off the sets as they fill; the 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting well past 3. Trade route planning matters more than speed: finish one region before moving to the next. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Sweep one region at a time for collectible cards.
Complete 3 full card sets.
Keep collecting toward 15 sets for 100%.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. The WAiNK spots split 31, 35 and 23 across three groups, so work through the map region by region and tick each spot off as you go. It is a long sweep of 6 to 10 hours, so fold it into your collectible runs and travel routes instead of treating it as one marathon. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GTA Zone.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the map and plan a region-by-region WAiNK route.
WAiNK It at each location and tick it off.
Reach 100 locations across Leonida.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10. Challenges reward the way you already play — driving, shooting, exploring and causing chaos — so they pile up naturally along the way, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of them. The challenge list shows your progress in eight groups of ten, so scan it after each session and chase the groups closest to done. Driving stunts and clean getaways fill several groups at once without any extra effort. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenge list and note the nearly-done ones.
Play toward those challenges during normal sessions.
Reach 50 completed, then push to 70 for 100%.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. This needs Jason and Lucia together, so do it while both are playable and partnered, before the story moves past that window. Build heat to 4 stars away from heavy police cover, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: Needs Jason and Lucia together — do it while both are playable and partnered.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Wait until Jason and Lucia are partnered and both playable.
Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight and escape until the heat clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and needs Jason and Lucia together, so do it while both are playable and partnered. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep the same wanted level through all three without letting it drop. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: Opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — needs Jason and Lucia together, so do it while both are playable and partnered.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break first.
Plan a route of three shops close together.
Rob all three back-to-back with your partner, keeping the wanted level.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida. Vehicles register when you find and scan them, and there are 277 base models in the game, with the 100% checklist needing 200 scanned. Drive everywhere, check parking lots and side streets, and scan each new model you spot. Rare models hide in wealthy districts and industrial yards, so vary your routes instead of circling the same blocks. Every scan counts toward the 200 needed for 100%, so keep the scanner habit all game. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GamesRadar.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan every new vehicle model you spot.
Check parking lots and side streets for rare models.
Reach 100 discovered, then push toward 200 for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a tight group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five of them before the effect ends. Pick a mission or shootout with clustered enemies rather than a scattered street fight, and use a weapon with a fast fire rate. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Output Lag.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with a tight group of enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus when they cluster.
Take down 5 enemies before the effect ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport, in a one-off setup, so save before you try it. A failed attempt means re-planning the approach, so scout the airport first, pick your route to a plane, and commit once you are sure. Reload the save if it goes wrong and try a different angle. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, gtasix.how.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off setup — save before you try it; a failed attempt means re-planning the approach.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Make a manual save before heading to VCIA.
Scout the airport and pick your route to a plane.
Make the unscheduled departure; reload and retry if it fails.

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble until the trophy pops. Tanks draw heavy police attention, so the trick is surviving long enough in the open: use wide streets, keep moving so you are a hard target, and let the chaos build around you. About half an hour of mayhem should do it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GTA Zone.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Get into a Rhino tank.
Head for wide open streets and keep moving.
Cause chaos until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, using the Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 mission. Plan the robbery quietly: case the store, move when the staff look away, and keep the Snap Gun ready for the quiet approach. If you are spotted, reload the save and try again rather than fighting through it, since detection voids the trophy. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.missableNote: Needs the Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 mission — do the robbery undetected; if spotted, reload the save.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Get the Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 mission.
Save before the robbery and case the store.
Rob the jewelry store undetected; reload if spotted.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Bank vaults are the bigger heist-style robberies, so plan the getaway before you go in: a fast car parked close, a route away from police, and armour for the escape. Vault jobs pay well on top of the trophy, so the cash you grab funds the garage and shop spending trophies at the same time. Bring a crew mindset even when solo: speed matters more than firepower once the alarm sounds. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Plan a getaway car and escape route first.
Rob a bank vault and escape cleanly.
Repeat for 5 vaults, then all 8 for 100%.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape. Trucks follow set routes, so watch traffic for one, block it or force it to stop, crack it open, grab the cash and get clear before the police close in. Highways outside the city centre are good hunting grounds, since trucks run long straight routes there. Wait for a quiet stretch, then strike fast and vanish down a side street before the wanted level climbs. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Output Lag.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Watch the roads for an armored truck.
Stop the truck and crack it open.
Grab the cash and escape before police arrive.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida across its 52 areas to earn this trophy. Drive and walk the whole map, from Vice City's streets to the swamps and beaches, until every area registers as visited. The swamp roads and beach highways hide several areas that a straight city drive never touches, so take the long way around the map at least once. Every area you enter registers immediately, so you can watch the count climb as you travel. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive through every region of the map.
Visit all 52 areas, including swamps and beaches.
Fold the sweep into collectible runs.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida, so track them down gang by gang and hit one operation per gang. Gang operations hide in warehouses, back rooms and dockside yards, so search the industrial districts as well as the streets. Each gang's turf has its own look, which makes the nine easy to tell apart once you know the signs. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, GTA Zone.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find the illegal operations run by each gang.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Keep going toward all 39 operations for 100%.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This trophy is UNCONFIRMED: no verified method exists yet, so do not chase a rumoured trick. The description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, which suggests a beachfront bar spot, but until a source confirms the exact trigger, treat any claimed method as unverified. Check the cited sources for updates before spending time on it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and look for a beachfront bar spot.
Try enjoying a cocktail with the view.
Check the cited sources for a confirmed trigger before retrying.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This trophy is UNCONFIRMED, and it is also a one-off smash, so save before you try it: a failed run means finding another showroom. The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom, so the idea is to drive through the showroom glass in classic style, but no source has confirmed the exact trigger yet. Save first, try once, and check the cited sources for confirmation. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off smash — save before you try it; a failed run means finding another showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Make a manual save before the attempt.
Drive a vehicle into a showroom and smash your way out.
Check the cited sources for a confirmed trigger if it fails.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Chapter 2 and follow through on a bowl there. Bowling is one of the activity types, so it also counts toward trying each activity once. Bowling alleys are easy to miss if you never visit them, so make the trip while you are in Chapter 2 rather than leaving it for the post-story cleanup. One finished frame is all it takes, and the trophy pops right after. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a bowling game.
Follow through on a bowl to finish the frame.

trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts wash them into clean cash, so keep robbing and laundering steadily from Chapter 3 onward. Marked Bills pile up fastest from the vault and armored truck robberies, so launder after every big score instead of letting dirty money sit. trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. The counter covers every shop, so buy weapons, ammo, clothes, food and vehicle upgrades as you play instead of hoarding cash. Weapons and ammo eat the biggest share, so buy a new gun and a full stock of rounds whenever a shop is nearby. Clothes, snacks and vehicle paint also count, so spread the spending across different shop types to keep the total climbing on every trip. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Sixshore.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect, so buy them as you find them from Chapter 2 onward rather than waiting until the end. Garages are spread across the map, so buy each one the moment you pass it rather than planning a separate shopping tour. Storing the vehicles you discover also helps the vehicle sweep, so the two goals feed each other. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, Push Square, Output Lag.
